name: 进校门
description: 早上来到学校门口
清晨的阳光洒在学校门口，空气里带着淡淡的青草香。
长颈鹿老师正弯着身子，用扫帚轻轻扫着落叶，远处传来学生们的笑声。
descriptionEn: The morning sun shines on the school gate, and the air carries a faint scent of grass.
The giraffe teacher is bending down, gently sweeping fallen leaves with a broom, and laughter from students can be heard in the distance.

interactions.dialogue: 老师：早上好呀，小同学～今天看起来精神不错呀！
interactions.dialogueEn: Teacher: Good morning, little student! You look energetic today!

description: 你大声向老师打招呼：「老师早上好」，声音像早晨的阳光一样明亮。
长颈鹿老师笑着回应：「早上好，你的声音真有力量」
她的笑容让空气都变得温暖。
descriptionEn: You greet the teacher loudly: "Good morning, teacher!", your voice as bright as the morning sun.
The giraffe teacher smiles and responds: "Good morning, your voice is so powerful!"
Her smile makes the air feel warm and happy.

description: 老师轻轻牵着你的手，向校园里走去。
她的声音在阳光下轻轻回荡：「一起进去吧。」
你笑着回答：「Okay!」
descriptionEn: The teacher gently takes your hand and walks toward the campus.
Her voice gently echoes in the sunlight: "Let's go in together."
You smile and reply: "Okay!"

description: 你和老师走进校园，前方站着一位高大的大象保安。
他手里拿着一支体温枪，正微笑着迎接每一位同学。
你抬头看向老师，心里有一点好奇。
descriptionEn: You and the teacher walk into the campus, and ahead stands a tall elephant security guard.
He holds a temperature gun in his hand, smiling and greeting each student.
You look up at the teacher, feeling a bit curious.

interactions.dialogue: 大象保安：早上好，小家伙！该测体温啦！
interactions.dialogueEn: Security Guard: Good morning, little one! Time to check your temperature!

options.text: 主动伸出额头：「我准备好了！」
好奇地问：「这个会不会凉呀？」

options.textEn: Step back half a step, feeling a bit hesitant

description: 你立刻踮起脚，主动把额头伸向保安叔叔。
他有些惊喜地笑了，说：「哇，好勇敢！你已经准备好了呀！」
你大声回答：「我准备好了!」
descriptionEn: You immediately stand on tiptoe and actively extend your forehead toward the security guard.
He smiles with surprise and says: "Wow, so brave! You're already ready!"
You answer loudly: "I'm ready!"

description: 你抬头看着保安叔叔手里的体温枪，眼睛里闪着好奇，问：「这个会不会凉呀？」
保安笑着摇摇头，说：「不会的，很温和，一点也不凉。」
descriptionEn: You look up at the temperature gun in the security guard's hand, your eyes sparkling with curiosity, and ask: "Will this be cold?"
The security guard smiles and shakes his head, saying: "No, it's very gentle, not cold at all."

description: 你下意识地往后退了一小步，手抓紧了背包带。
保安叔叔和老师蹲下身，笑着对你说：「别担心，小家伙，只是'滴'的一声而已。」「看吧，很安全的。」
descriptionEn: You instinctively take a small step back, gripping your backpack strap tightly.
The security guard and teacher squat down and say with a smile: "Don't worry, little one, it's just a 'beep' sound." "See, it's very safe."

description: 测完体温后，你和老师一起向教学楼走去。
身后的保安叔叔向你挥手告别。
阳光洒在走廊上，新的校园一天正式开始。
descriptionEn: After checking your temperature, you and the teacher walk toward the teaching building together.
The security guard behind you waves goodbye.
Sunlight shines on the corridor, and a new school day officially begins.

description: 你轻轻挥手，对老师露出笑容。
老师也笑着回礼，说道：「早上好！你的笑容真漂亮。」
阳光落在你的脸上，笑容让空气都变得柔软。
descriptionEn: You gently wave your hand and smile at the teacher.
The teacher also smiles back and says: "Good morning! Your smile is so beautiful."
Sunlight falls on your face, and your smile makes the air feel soft and warm.

description: 你低下头，轻轻点了点头。
老师弯下身微笑着问：「早上好呀，今天是不是有点害羞？」
你抬头看到老师温暖的笑容，心里慢慢变得放松。
descriptionEn: You lower your head and nod gently.
The teacher bends down with a smile and asks: "Good morning! Are you feeling a bit shy today?"
You look up and see the teacher's warm smile, and your heart gradually relaxes.
